_note: Hand-curated interaction rules that DDInter lacks: its bulk files do not hold several cardiovascular pairs, and Indian-only drugs are missing. Each rule expands to every a x b pair. Where DDInter also lists a pair, the more severe level is used. Severity and wording are drafts for the pharmacist to confirm. A rule with "interrupt": true is a contraindicated pair that stops the pharmacist (FIX_PLAN 1.1); "basis" names the label or list behind it, still to be verified by a pharmacist. Rules with "effect" say how the pair interacts ("reduces_effect": one drug weakens the drugs in "reduces"; "adds_effect": both add to the same effect) and carry the label sentences behind them in "evidence". "non_systemic" names ingredients whose eye/ear/skin lines still count (timolol eye drops are absorbed).
